verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. the monitoring, export, audit and transaction endpoint pages). It also offers an official Postman collection with runnable requests and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema that was retrieved unauthenticated. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console. Runnable examples come only through the separate Postman collection. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-reference request console, embedded runnable code samples, independent hands-on corroboration.
